## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check:all`
- [ ] PostgreSQL integration tests, when database behavior changed
- [ ] Manual macOS/Windows or UI verification, when applicable

## Review Notes

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior change
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese user-facing text stay synchronized
- [ ] Security, persistence, migration, performance, and compatibility impact is documented
- [ ] No credentials, production data, generated fixtures, signing material, or build artifacts are included
- [ ] Documentation and third-party notices are updated when required
